## More from Statz [...] # Orlando City vs Cincinnati Predictions, Team News and Betting Tips

Updated 17 November 2026.

Orlando City host Cincinnati at Spectrum Stadium in the MLS Cup play-in round, kicking off at 00:30 UK on Friday 20 November. Both finished the regular season in the Eastern Conference on 46 points from 34 games, Orlando 8th and Cincinnati 9th. Orlando concede the 2nd most goals per game at home in MLS and Cincinnati the 3rd most away, and we project 4.13 goals between them.

Orlando line up in a 3-4-1-2 formation. Crépeau has started every recent match and recorded 14 saves, so he remains the clear choice in goal. Martin Ojeda sits behind the front two as the attacking midfielder, and he has taken 14 shots in the last five matches. We expect Braian Ojeda to provide the link to the wide areas, and Atuesta to protect the central channel.

### FC Cincinnati possible starting eleven [...] Cincinnati set up in a 4-4-2 formation. Celentano has played every minute of the last five matches and made 15 saves, which makes him a reliable presence. Denkey has logged the most minutes among the forwards, and Ramirez offers pace on the other side. Tom Barlow could return to the front line if the coaching staff wants more direct threat, with his eight shots and one goal making him a useful option.

## TipsGG Match Prediction

We predict a low-scoring draw, perhaps 1-1, with both teams finding the net. Cincinnati have the better form over the last 30 days and the stronger ball progression, but Orlando’s shape and counter threat should keep the tie level. To be honest, the margin is slim, and the draw offers the best return for our money.
